{{Infobox auto}}

'''Paneer makhani''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 10 minutes, the longest Regeneration from food.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/paneer_makhani.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[paneer curry stock]] cooks into paneer makhani in 15 seconds in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Regeneration I for 10:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_39.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Sweet and Spicy!'': make paneer makhani. The description adds "All Foods have viable Vegetarian Options" (1 [[obol]]).
